Questions

Before you start

Is this therapy?

No. It's a self-guided educational kit of audios and exercises for calm and confidence. It isn't a replacement for therapy or medication. If you're struggling, please speak to your GP.

I've never tried hypnotherapy. Is that OK?

Yes. Day 1 explains what to expect. You simply listen somewhere comfortable where you won't be disturbed, never while driving.

How much time does it take?

About 10 to 15 minutes a day for seven days. Go at your own pace, and keep access.

What if it's not for me?

[Your refund terms, for example a 14-day guarantee like your other programmes.]

What happens after the 7 days?

If you want to keep going, the Hypnotherapy Collection goes deeper, and you can apply to work with me 1:1.
